title: Potential avoidance of liquidation
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  Users can deposit ERC721 tokens using the `MarginTrading::provideERC721` function, which can then be used as collateral for borrowing. Additionally, users can execute the `MarginTrading::exercise` function to convert their ERC721 into `baseToken` value, crediting the respective `marginAccount`.
